entry.title: H5 · Falsification harness
entry.subtitle: Novelty hypothesis
entry.summary: Pair every certified configuration with the best known *attack* (Monte Carlo lower bounds, SDP optima at small n) so certificates can be shown to be non-vacuous and to fail when they should.

fields.label: Statement
fields.text: Pair every certified configuration with the best known *attack* (Monte Carlo lower bounds, SDP optima at small n) so certificates can be shown to be non-vacuous and to fail when they should. This is engineering. It doesn't produce new bounds.
